ResearchProjectDef.label: Broadcaster drone
ResearchProjectDef.description: Design and build a drone is equipped with a small megaphone. It is useful for boosting morale among colonists, or deploying propaganda against different ways of thinking or prisoners.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Battle drone
ResearchProjectDef.description: Design and build a combat-oriented drone for military use. The drone is equipped with a small stubgun, making it a decent opponent on the battlefield.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Hauler drone
ResearchProjectDef.description: Design and build a treaded drone for hauling and transportation tasks. The drone is equipped with small prongs, making it proficient in moving items around.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Miner drone
ResearchProjectDef.description: Design and build a specialized drone for mining operations. The drone is equipped with a small drill, making it proficient in extracting resources.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Turret drone
ResearchProjectDef.description: Design and build a specialized drone for defensive operations. The drone is equipped with a small turret, designed to provide stationary fire support while being able to be moved if necessary.
